headline: Ethiopia Becomes Africa's Fifth-Largest Economy After GDP Rebasing
summary: Ethiopia became Africa's fifth-largest economy after revising its gross domestic product figures to account for sectors including digital finance, services, and manufacturing, valuing the economy at $210.7 billion.
why: GDP revisions and rebasing update the economic baseline of a country, offering investors a more accurate reflection of industrial output, sectoral growth, and market size in developing regions.

impacts.name: Ethiopia
impacts.why: GDP rebasing formally increases the recorded size of Ethiopia's economy.
